discription: A square wave with a pulsing amplitude modulation, creating a rhythmic effect.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, modFreq=4;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var modulator = SinOsc.kr(modFreq).range(0.2, 1.0);    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth) * amp * env * modulator;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
